subject: Mathematics
question_possibility: Determine parameter conditions under which a parametric matrix is a real matrix
archetype: Simultaneous reality constraints in a parameterized matrix
assessment_mechanism: Translate the requirement that an entire parameterized matrix is real into simultaneous zero-imaginary-part constraints on its entries, then solve the resulting parameter system.
reasoning_path: Inspect each matrix entry; isolate its imaginary part; set every imaginary part to zero; solve the simultaneous equations; check that the resulting parameter values satisfy every entry.
variation_dimensions: number of constrained entries | number of parameters | independent versus dependent constraints | linear versus nonlinear parameter conditions

subject: Mathematics
question_possibility: Determine whether scalar multiplication or linear combinations yield a real matrix and identify conditions on scalar coefficients
archetype: Reality of a linear combination of real matrices
assessment_mechanism: Determine the scalar-coefficient conditions under which a linear combination of real matrices has only real entries, using entrywise imaginary-part equations and any stated linear-independence information.
reasoning_path: Write the imaginary parts of the scalar coefficients; form the matrix equation for the imaginary component of the combination; use the matrix independence or dependence conditions to solve for admissible coefficients; verify the result entrywise.
variation_dimensions: number of matrices in the combination | linear independence or dependence | coefficient constraints | presence of zero or repeated matrices
